messages.subject: [Installation Error]

Here is some information.

Bests,

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] [Installation Error]
parts:
The problem is htslib in the development version of R, try to use the release version for dependencies or simply use the release version on bioC

Best
Altuna
